items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: He played uptown. He played bands around there, uptown, uptown there.

ctx.x: No, no, no. My drum player, he died, he died, Roy Evans. Oh yeah? Yeah. Well, he must be Lee Collins first? He was good boy. He was really good. He was really good. He just died. No, not Lee. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little while ago.
Did you ever know a drummer called Rachel? Rachel?
Rachel? Mm-hmm. You got to think I know him.
